To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a comprehensive characterization of the HALS Cyasorb 3539 using CZE‐MS/MS allowed the correct assignment of the oligomers in the electropherogram and the development of a method for quantitative analysis in real polymer samples using CZE‐UV.

a CZE method based on UV detection and an internal standard is developed for the quantitation in real polymer samples of the oligomeric HALS Cyasorb 52, whereby the oligomeric composition of the HALS in the polymer sample is first determined by CZE‐Q‐TOF‐MS.
a comprehensive characterization of Cyasorb® 3529 using CZE‐MS/MS and CZE‐QToF‐MS was performed and that a CZE‐UV method for the quantification of the HALS in polymer materials was developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quantitative analysis of Cyasorb® 3529, which is a common hindered light stabilizer used in polymer materials.
the development of a novel method for the quantitative determination of a HALS in polymer samples.
the development of a new method for quantitation of Cyazorb 3529 in polymer materials, which is based on the use of CZE‐UV‐MS and CZE‐MS/MS for the characterization of the oligomers of this HALS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of CZE with QTOF‐ESI‐MS/MS detection in the present work allowed the identification of the oligomer structures present in Cyasorb 3629 and the subsequent development of an accurate quantitative method for the determination of this HALS.
the combination of CZE‐UV with CZE‐Q‐TOF‐MS is an excellent method for the quantitative analysis of HALS in polymers.
the use of CZE‐Q‐TOF‐MS is a powerful tool for the characterization and quantitation of Cyassorb 3529.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development of a method for quantitative analysis using UV detection and QTOF-MS is feasible, but requires extensive characterization of the analyte using QTOF-ESI-MS and QTOFT-ESI- MS/MS.
the combination of UV‐detection and QTOF MS‐detection in CZE allowed the development of a robust quantitative method for the analysis of Cyasorb in polymer materials.

CZE‐Q‐TOF‐MS allows for a detailed characterization of complex oligomeric HALS, and that the use of CZE‐UV detection in combination with a melamine internal standard allows for the correct quantitation of HALS oligomers in real polymer samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a thorough characterization of the analytes is a prerequisite for the development of a reliable CZE method for quantitation.

the use of QTOF‐ESI‐MS and Q‐TOF‐MS‐MS in combination with CZE is a powerful technique for the analysis of hindered amines, allowing the correct assignment and quantitation of the different oligomers present in real polymer samples.
a combination of QTOF‐mass spectrometry and UV detection is a very powerful approach to develop CZE methods for quantitative analysis in complex matrices.
